SOURCE_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the source in the provider's
registry of sources.

SOURCE_KIND.description: What kind of data the source supplies.

ORIGINATOR.description:
Agency, operator or catalog that created the source data, as it names
itself. Not a message's CCSDS ORIGINATOR, which names who created the
message.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Identifier of the provider that published the product, as the provider
names itself: the module, node or service that retrieved the source data.

PRODUCER.description:
Identifier of the software that made the product from the source data,
with its version when it has one.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: What the source's terms permit for the product.

LICENSE_ID.description:
Identifier of the terms LICENSE_CLASS was read from: an SPDX license
identifier where one applies, else the identifier of the terms in the
provider's licence register.

LINEAGE.description:
Identifier of the lineage the source's data descends from. Sources that
republish one upstream share its lineage, so their products are not
independent of each other.

SOURCE_URL.description:
Replayable URL or provider query identifying the source material as it
was retrieved (the SOURCE_URL of $CMR and $AVL).

SOURCE_VERSION.description:
Source revision, edition or upstream update marker verbatim: for a file
its originator stamps, the stamp.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond time the source material was retrieved.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact source payload bytes as retrieved, 64 lowercase
hexadecimal characters. Empty when the source cannot expose replayable
bytes.

SOURCE_BYTES.description:
Number of source bytes SOURCE_SHA256 covers: the length of the prefix when
the source was fetched by range. 0 when not stated.

PRODUCER_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the build of PRODUCER that made the product (its dist
module.wasm), 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Stamped by the host
that loaded the producing module: a module cannot hash its own bytes.
Empty when not stated.

THPProvenance.description: Provenance and classification metadata for a threat parameter.

SOURCE_URI.description: URI or canonical source identifier for this parameter.

PUBLISHED_DATE.description: Publication or revision date, ISO 8601 UTC.

CERTAINTY.description: Epistemic certainty level of the parameter value.

ACCESS_TIER.description: Access tier governing visibility of this parameter.

THPReference.description: Typed reference to an existing SDS record without duplicating its fields.

SCHEMA_FILE_ID.description: Four-character SDS file identifier including "$", e.g. "$OMM", "$RFB", "$SIT".

RECORD_ID.description: Canonical identifier of the referenced record within that standard.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Optional catalog number when the referenced record targets a cataloged object.

CID.description: Optional content identifier pinning exact immutable record bytes.

ROLE.description: Role of the referenced record in this threat profile (e.g. "PLATFORM", "EMITTER", "SITE").

THPParameter.description: One typed capability or environmental threshold parameter on a threat profile.

VALUE_KIND.description: Discriminator naming which value field is populated.

NUMERIC_VALUE.description: Numeric parameter value when VALUE_KIND is SCALAR_DOUBLE.

TEXT_VALUE.description: String parameter value when VALUE_KIND is TEXT.

BOOL_VALUE.description: Boolean parameter value when VALUE_KIND is BOOLEAN.

UNITS.description: Physical units string for numeric values (e.g. "km", "dBW", "MHz", "nm").

THP_ID.description: Stable identifier of this threat profile.

NAME.description: Human-readable display name of the threat profile.

DESCRIPTION.description: Summary description of the threat profile and scope.

ACCESS_TIER.description: Minimum access tier required to consume this threat profile.

ACTIVE.description: True when the threat profile is active for screening runs.

LINKED_SCHEMA.description: Four-character SDS file identifier including "$" of the primary linked record.

LINKED_RECORD_ID.description: Canonical record identifier of the primary linked SDS record.

LINKED_NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Optional NORAD catalog number of the primary linked space object.

ADDITIONAL_REFS.description: Additional linked SDS records referenced by ($SCHEMA_FILE_ID, RECORD_ID).

PARAMETERS.description: Typed capability and threshold parameters with per-parameter provenance.

SIGNATURE.description: Optional Ed25519 signature bytes over the canonical threat lane payload.
